Subject: Ledger sprint walkthrough — 24hr close plan

Team / Jordan — quick alignment for the 24hr close window. I want to keep this tight and tactical. Key ask: by EOD tomorrow (Dec 5) we need final commit status + PO or clear blocker for each deal in the attached roster. High-level plan below, then owner asks.

1) Priority gating (what must be in place to mark as COMMIT):
  - Signed PO received (procurement email or DocuSign link) OR
  - Confirmed purchase order number + finance approval (credit check cleared)
  - Legal redline cleared (if any) OR explicit legal waiver accepted

2) Stage hygiene updates required in the roster (please update HubSpot + attach the PO to the deal):
  - Move to "Contract - PO Pending" if PO is expected but not signed yet (include ETA)
  - Move to "At Risk" only when procurement has said >72h delay

3) Daily checkpoints:
  - 10:30 PT stand-up (15m) to call out hard blockers
  - Rolling Slack updates in #rev-close (please tag @irene for escalations)

Owners / asks:
  - David: confirm final ARR numbers for deals >$100k and update the roster column "Finance Confirmed".
  - Ben: lead credit approvals; if finance flags, escalate to Laura.
  - Laura: legal redline triage for Acme/Novas (see notes row 7).
  - Monica: run PO chase with Acme procurement + confirm expected submission time.

Jordan — can you confirm procurement will push PO by EOD Dec 5 for the three line items we discussed? If there are any new conditions, call them out here.

Attachments: commit_roster_20261204.xlsx, po_tracker_acme.pdf

Thanks — short and steady on this one.

Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
